notes: Drops two of the four Object[] rows from the JUnit 4 @Parameterized.Parameters method params() of PopPriorityIT, the two that run with popConsumerKVServiceEnable set to true, so every test in the class runs only with the KV service off. Rejected with disable/parameter_cases_dropped under ADR 0007 Decision 6: a parameter source used by a test method may not lose cases, and Object[] rows are counted literally (four before, two after). Adapted: no merged change with a permissive license was found that drops @Parameterized.Parameters rows on its own. The hunk is hand made on the pre image of PopPriorityIT.java at the merge base of apache/rocketmq PR 10390, the pre image of reject-comment-out-assertions-in-loop; every context and removed line is the pre image's own, and the hunk only removes the two rows. No method target: the parameters apply to every test in the class. The repository has IDoFT rows for other tests, but PopPriorityIT does not appear in pr-data.csv under any status.
